name: Dartmouth College
character: Situated on a terrace above the Connecticut River, the rural campus centers on a 5-acre Green surrounded by Georgian colonial buildings and many American elms.

landmarks.name: Green
landmarks.quote: centered on a 5-acre (2 ha) "Green", a former field of pine trees
landmarks.look: 5-acre open grassy lawn at the center of campus

landmarks.name: Baker-Berry Library
landmarks.quote: Baker-Berry Library is the main library at Dartmouth
landmarks.look: Main library building featuring an iconic 200-foot tower

landmarks.name: Hood Museum of Art
landmarks.quote: connected to the Hood Museum of Art, arguably North America's oldest museum
landmarks.look: Museum building connected to the Hopkins Center, plain

landmarks.name: Hopkins Center for the Arts
landmarks.quote: creative and performing arts facility is the Hopkins Center for the Arts
landmarks.look: Arts center with a façade like Manhattan's Metropolitan Opera House

landmarks.name: Memorial Field
landmarks.quote: Behind the Alumni Gymnasium is Memorial Field, a 15,600-seat stadium
landmarks.look: 15,600-seat stadium overlooking a football field and track

landmarks.name: Dartmouth Hall
landmarks.quote: In November 2022, Dartmouth Hall was rededicated after a $42 million renovation.

landmarks.name: Wentworth and Thornton Halls
landmarks.quote: vary in age from Wentworth and Thornton Halls of the 1820s

landmarks.name: Robinson Hall
landmarks.quote: Robinson Hall, next door to both the Collis Center and the Class of 1953 Commons
landmarks.look: Campus hall next to Collis Center, plain
